PROJECT SETUP:
- Framework: Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript (strict mode)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v3.4
- Components: shadcn/ui (button, card, badge, separator)
- Animations: Framer Motion
- Icons: Lucide React
- Deployment target: Docker + Nginx

FILE STRUCTURE:
app/
├── layout.tsx (root layout with metadata)
├── page.tsx (main landing page)
├── globals.css (Tailwind + custom CSS variables)
components/
├── sections/
│   ├── Hero.tsx
│   ├── Projects.tsx
│   ├── Skills.tsx
│   └── Contact.tsx
├── ui/ (shadcn components)
lib/
├── utils.ts
└── constants.ts (project data)

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:

1. HERO COMPONENT (components/sections/Hero.tsx):
- Full viewport height section
- Animated gradient background (CSS gradients with @keyframes)
- Two floating gradient orbs (position: absolute, animation, blur filter)
- Content: h1 (text-6xl), h2 (gradient text with bg-clip-text), description, 2 CTAs
- Framer Motion: fadeInUp animations with stagger
- Social links with hover effects
- Scroll indicator (animated)

2. PROJECTS COMPONENT (components/sections/Projects.tsx):
Define projects array in lib/constants.ts:
```typescript

  {
    id: 'agentlogic',
    icon: '🤖',
    name: 'AgentLogic Academy',
    description: 'Plataforma de aprendizaje de programación con IA, gamificación y 30+ ejercicios prácticos',

    url: 'https://agentlogic.bitxodev.com',
    gradient: 'from-purple-500 to-blue-500'
  },
  // ... 4 more projects
]
```

- Grid layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3
- Card component with:
  - Glassmorphism: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-lg
  - Border: border border-white/10
  - Hover: scale-105 transition-transform duration-300
  - Framer Motion: scroll-triggered animations with useInView
- Tech badges: flex wrap with pill-shaped badges
- CTA button with arrow icon and hover animation

3. SKILLS COMPONENT:
- Flex grid layout with gap-3
- Skills array from constants
- Each skill: pill badge with hover:scale-105
- Framer Motion: stagger animation on scroll

4. CONTACT COMPONENT:
- Social links with icons
- Email with gradient button
- Hover effects on all links

STYLING REQUIREMENTS:
- Dark theme base: bg-slate-950
- Accent colors: purple-600, blue-500
- Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-lg, bg-white/5
- Shadows: shadow-xl shadow-purple-500/20
- Transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out
- Responsive: mobile-first with sm:, md:, lg: breakpoints

ANIMATION REQUIREMENTS:
- Import: import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'
- Hero animations: sequential fadeInUp with 0.2s delays
- Scroll animations: trigger when 20% of element visible
- Hover states: scale, translate, glow effects
- Background orbs: infinite rotation and scale animations

PERFORMANCE:
- Next.js Image optimization
- Lazy load below-fold sections
- Minimize layout shift (CLS)
- Optimize animations (transform/opacity only)

DEPLOYMENT:
Create Dockerfile:
```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=build /app/out /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
```

Create docker-compose.yml for deployment

DELIVERABLES:
- All component files
- Tailwind config with custom colors
- Constants file with all project data

- README with setup instructions

# Production-Ready Developer Portfolio

A high-performance landing page built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Features
- **Modern UI**: Glassmorphism, dark theme, and high-fidelity typography.
- **Animations**: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered and stagger effects.
- **Performance**: Optimized asset loading and minimized layout shifts.
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first design approach.

## Tech Stack
- Framework: Vite / React 18
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v3.4
- Icons: Lucide React
- Animation: Framer Motion

## Getting Started

1. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

2. Run development server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

3. Build for production:
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```

## Docker Deployment

To run in a containerized environment:
```bash
docker-compose up -d --build
```
